 RE:
 
 
 ConAgra Foods, Inc.

Form 10-K for the Fiscal Year ended May 29, 2011 (the Form 10-K )

Filed July 19, 2011 

 
 

 Dear Mr. Skinner:

 We acknowledge receipt of the Staffs comment letter dated September 15, 2011 on the above
referenced Form 10-K. Pursuant to Lyn Rhotens conversation with you today, we are requesting an
extension of time for ConAgra Foods, Inc. ( ConAgra Foods ) to respond to the comment
letter until October 6, 2011.

 Please
contact me at 402-240-5381 with questions or comments on this response letter.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 Very truly yours,

 
 

 
 
 /s/ John F. Gehring
 
 

 
 
 John F. Gehring 
 

 
 
 Executive Vice President
and Chief Financial Officer
